description: This file is a JSON schema defining the 'System' API for a set-top box or similar embedded system. It specifies data structures, methods, events, and documentation for interacting with system-level features such as firmware updates, device info, power management, and system configuration.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Collects device details such as MAC addresses, firmware version, model, etc. (Deprecated, use specific APIs like DeviceInfo.make instead)

methods.name: getDownloadedFirmwareInfo
methods.description: Returns information about firmware downloads, including current and downloaded firmware versions, location, and reboot status.

methods.name: getFirmwareDownloadPercent
methods.description: Gets the current download percentage for firmware updates.

methods.name: getFirmwareUpdateInfo
methods.description: Checks for available firmware updates and triggers an asynchronous event with firmware update info.

methods.name: getFirmwareUpdateState
methods.description: Checks the current state of the firmware update process.

methods.name: getLastFirmwareFailureReason
methods.description: Retrieves the reason for the last firmware update failure if any.

methods.name: getLastWakeupKeyCode
methods.description: Returns the last key code used to wake up the device.

methods.name: getMacAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves various MAC addresses (Ethernet, WiFi, Bluetooth, etc.) of the device.

methods.name: getMfgSerialNumber
methods.description: Returns the manufacturing serial number.

methods.name: getNetworkStandbyMode
methods.description: Returns whether network standby mode is supported.

methods.name: getPlatformConfiguration
methods.description: Returns supported features and device/account info based on query.

methods.name: getPowerState
methods.description: Returns the current power state of the device.

methods.name: getPowerStateBeforeReboot
methods.description: Returns the power state of the device before a reboot occurred.

methods.name: getRFCConfig
methods.description: Returns RFC configuration properties related to feature control.

methods.name: getSerialNumber
methods.description: Returns the device serial number.

methods.name: getSystemVersions
methods.description: Provides detailed system version information.

methods.name: getFriendlyName
methods.description: Returns the user-friendly name of the device.

methods.name: getTerritory
methods.description: Gets the configured system territory and region.

methods.name: getTimeZones
methods.description: (Version2) Retrieves available time zones from system database.

methods.name: getTimeZoneDST
methods.description: Retrieves the configured timezone and its accuracy.

methods.name: getWakeupReason
methods.description: Returns the reason why the device woke up from deep sleep.

methods.name: isOptOutTelemetry
methods.description: Checks whether telemetry data collection is opted out.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Requests the system to reboot.

methods.name: requestSystemUptime
methods.description: Returns the system uptime in seconds.

methods.name: setDeepSleepTimer
methods.description: Sets the timeout period for deep sleep.

methods.name: setFirmwareAutoReboot
methods.description: Enables or disables automatic reboot after firmware update.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the system mode (NORMAL, EAS, WAREHOUSE) for a specified duration.

methods.name: setNetworkStandbyMode
methods.description: Enables or disables network standby mode of the device.

methods.name: setOptOutTelemetry
methods.description: Sets telemetry data collection opt-out status.

methods.name: setPowerState
methods.description: Sets the power state (ON, STANDBY, etc.) of the device.

methods.name: setFriendlyName
methods.description: Sets the user-friendly name for the device.

methods.name: setBootLoaderSplashScreen
methods.description: Installs or updates the bootloader splash screen.

methods.name: getBuildType
methods.description: Returns the build type of the current device image.

methods.name: setTerritory
methods.description: Sets the device territory and region.

methods.name: setTimeZoneDST
methods.description: Configures the system timezone and accuracy.

methods.name: setWakeupSrcConfiguration
methods.description: Configures wakeup sources; deprecated, use setWakeupSrcConfiguration.

methods.name: updateFirmware
methods.description: Initiates a firmware update when available.

methods.name: uploadLogsAsync
methods.description: Starts background log upload.

methods.name: abortLogUpload
methods.description: Stops background log upload.
